nodes.label: lastModifiedFrom incremental checkpoint strategy
nodes.rationale: Verified via live GET probes 2026-08-30 against KiotViet Hanoi account: lastModifiedFrom works for categories/products/customers/suppliers/invoices/orders/returns/purchases; fromOrderDate is silently ignored by /orders (contradicts PlanDB-Phase1-Spec.md §9.1 assumption); fromPurchaseDate/toPurchaseDate work but only filter by sale date, missing invoices edited later, so lastModifiedFrom is chosen for semantic correctness of 'changed since'.

nodes.label: pg-types DATE local-timezone bug
nodes.rationale: pg@8.23.0 pins pg-types@2.2.0, whose parseDate (from postgres-date) builds bare DATE values via new Date(year,month-1,day) in local time; calling .toISOString() shifts the date backward a day in positive-UTC-offset zones like Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Fixed via to_char(expr,'YYYY-MM-DD') to force TEXT output, sidestepping the client-side Date object. TIMESTAMPTZ columns are unaffected because parseDate takes a different, timezone-safe UTC branch for values with an explicit offset.

nodes.label: orders/returns lack upper-bound filter (backfill.js implication)
nodes.rationale: Live probe confirmed lastModifiedTo/toModifiedDate are ignored by /orders and /returns, so month-by-month chunking would re-download almost the entire dataset each 'month'; backfill.js instead does a single full run for these two entities, accepting known residual pagination-drift risk (per PlanDB.md §9) rather than pretending month-chunking works.
